verdict.rationale: Channel3 documents a first-party SDK with installation, authentication, and async calls, and its changelog announces an SDK 3.0.0 release alongside the /v1 API. The evidence is thin, however: it does not say which languages are supported, show SDK reference depth, or show anyone building with the SDK. missing for 10: documented language coverage (plural SDKs), SDK reference/method documentation depth, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Install the Channel3 SDK, authenticate, and make async calls.
